# HONDIT

> HONDIT is the selling and curation brand of a student team in the GTEP programme at Jeju National University (Jeju, Republic of Korea). It introduces StoneJeju Jeju volcanic-stone diffusers to overseas customers (Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Taiwan and more) with direct PayPal checkout. StoneJeju (stonejeju.com) makes the diffusers; HONDIT does not manufacture them. HONDIT is not JEJU STONE, HEJDIN or any other Jeju stone brand.

## What the product is called
A non-electric stone diffuser (aroma stone): porous Jeju volcanic scoria (lava stone, 송이 songi) in a glass vessel (350g) or Jeju onggi pottery (500g), with 10mL citrus fragrance oil. No electricity, no flame, no water, no reeds. Also searched as: lava stone diffuser, lava rock diffuser, waterless diffuser, reed diffuser alternative, Jeju souvenir, Korean gift; アロマストーン, 溶岩石 ディフューザー, 済州島 お土産; 擴香石, 火山石擴香, 濟州島手信, 伴手禮; 화산송이 디퓨저, 스톤 디퓨저, 제주 기념품.
